headline_rule: Headline (fixed before the test): for each map, each of the four validation-selected models (09b_selected_final.csv) against the fragility curves of the same map (municipality PGA), paired building by building on the test district. Primary metric RPS; also severe-damage Brier score and log loss. An improvement is claimed only if the mean paired RPS difference is negative AND its 95% cluster-bootstrap interval over the test district's 13 municipalities (2,000 resamples) excludes zero; otherwise 'no clear difference'. The number of municipalities where the model is better is reported alongside. All other runs are reported in a secondary table; the best test score among them is not a result. Post-hoc runs are labelled post-hoc.
